gap: No result ChatGPT got states what any of these NAS boxes costs today. On the maker's own US store, the UGREEN NASync DH2300 with UGREENlink is $239.99, the TerraMaster F2-425 is $269.99, the UGREEN DXP2800 is $389.99, and the Synology DS225+ is $364.99 at Abt. That makes the DH2300 the cheapest box priced today that comes with the maker's own relay for remote access.
standout_why: ChatGPT ran no searches and got no results, so there are no rival pages to compare against. Its answer names six brands (Synology, QNAP, UGREEN, ASUSTOR, TerraMaster, DIY/TrueNAS) and shows three catalog cards with no models or prices. Our current page also has only undated or launch-era prices ('DS223j $151–210 across 2026 listings', 'TS-233 about $289 (undated)', BeeStation Plus with a launch price and an Amazon price that disagree). Dated maker-store prices are new and useful. They don't decide the pick on their own, because the deciding factor is still how each relay behaves on CGNAT.
decides: This backs the DH2300 as the budget pick. At $239.99 on nas.ugreen.com it costs less than every other box I could price today and includes UGREENlink relay access. The nearest is the QNAP TS-233 at $247.78, and PCNation lists it as out of stock. Its myQNAPcloud Link relay is the one our current page says QNAP throttles to 'usually 1–2 Mbps' (I did not re-read that source this session). The TerraMaster F2-425 ($269.99) costs $30 more than the DH2300. The DXP2800 ($389.99) costs $150 more, and the money buys Docker, which is how you add Tailscale for a direct route. The Synology DS225+ ($364.99 at Abt) costs $125 more than the DH2300, and what it adds is Synology's official Tailscale package and QuickConnect.
